### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/plugin-approvals`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **12** documentable anchor(s).

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`  _(via bindApprovalLockHook (symbol, a top-level function))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **173** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6a7403bae14c7db5f21ad4a214198616aecf15f2` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `a01b275aae50162811dcdee6d5d1d9ee0a10f06f` — the merge of head `b5c0292deeeabbef3a246bfe39572dcd74e12003` into base `6a7403bae14c7db5f21ad4a214198616aecf15f2`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin a01b275aae50162811dcdee6d5d1d9ee0a10f06f && git checkout a01b275aae50162811dcdee6d5d1d9ee0a10f06f
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 6a7403bae14c7db5f21ad4a214198616aecf15f2 b5c0292deeeabbef3a246bfe39572dcd74e12003 && git checkout -B drift-repro 6a7403bae14c7db5f21ad4a214198616aecf15f2 && git merge --no-ff b5c0292deeeabbef3a246bfe39572dcd74e12003

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6a7403bae14c7db5f21ad4a214198616aecf15f2
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 6a7403bae14c7db5f21ad4a214198616aecf15f2` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对 · PR #34449 · L1-b · 2026-11-16T19:40Z
Head-sha: `b5c0292deeeabbef3a246bfe39572dcd74e12003`(merge-base a121e29c,2 个提交,7 个文件 +360/−10)

**结论:ACCEPT(内容)。** 有一条非阻塞的小意见。落地还须 L2 和 CI,见文末。

**已核对**
- **PR 形态:** `Fixes #34060`,Clause-② no,Metadata-protocol none。changeset 为 patch,覆盖 plugin-approvals 与 spec。
  - 新增的是 `BUILTIN_OPERATION_MESSAGES` 这个 `Record<string, Record<string, string>>` 里的条目,不是某个已发布 union 或 tuple 的新成员,所以 Clause-② no 站得住。
  - spec 路径被触及,欠一次 L2(区线程已请 review#1)。
- **英文逐字不变:** 旧模板字面量的四个分支(带标题和标签 / 只有标题 / `This ${label}` / `This record`)与新 `en` 的 `record_locked` / `_unlabeled` / `_untitled` / `_opaque` 四条逐字对应。哪种情况用哪个键,判断与旧的 `subject` 分支相同。
- **语言与标签:**
  - locale 取 `ctx.session.locale`;没有时由 `renderOperationMessage` 回落到 `en`。
  - 对象标签先取 `readerLabelsFor(service, locale)?.objectLabel(object)`,再回落到声明的标签,不用 API 名。
  - i18n 服务取不到或 `t()` 抛错,只会降级措辞,不影响锁本身:`refusalLocalization` 里有 try/catch,`renderOperationMessage` 自己也 catch。
  - 部署级 `errors.record_locked*` 覆盖走同一条梯子。
- **四种语言:** 都有这四个键,占位符一致。spec 测试断言了每种语言的键与占位符,以及英文逐字不变。
- **拒绝测试:**
  - 真引擎用例都断言了 `code` 为 `RECORD_LOCKED`、`statusCode` 409、`RECORD_LOCKED: ` 前缀、存储未变,以及句子全文或片段。覆盖的情形有:zh-CN 带标题与不带标题、裸 `zh`、en-US、`xx-YY`、无 locale、无 i18n、部署覆盖、i18n 抛错。
  - 批量行(`updateMany`、`batch` upsert)断言了 `code` 与 `httpStatus` 409。
- **docs / skills:** `approvals.mdx`、`state-machines-and-approvals.md` 和 API 参考只写了 `409 RECORD_LOCKED`,没有教这句英文,所以没有句子需要跟着改。
- **读数:**
  - main 上的 REST 重测与本分支对照,写在正文里。
  - 消融:把 locale 换成 `undefined` 后 7 红 / 14 绿,红的正好是 zh 和批量行的 locale 用例;还原后 blob 与 HEAD 一致。
  - 本 head 上 93/93 个门禁跑过,0 个 NOT-MEASURED。
  - 标题不带 `!`,也没有 narrowing,不欠 battery。

**备注(不阻塞)**
- N1:`operation-message.ts` 中 `BUILTIN_OPERATION_MESSAGES` 的 docblock 写成了 "…for a single field or none. *",下一行接 " * The four `record_locked*` keys…"。多出的那个 ` *` 把两段粘成了一段,发布的 `.d.ts` 注释里也会带上。下一轮改动时顺手修掉即可。

**未测量:** 本 head 的 CI 我读的时候是 18 success、12 skipped、18 in progress,无 failure,尚未跑完。

落地条款:须 review#1 的 L2 契约复审 PASS(spec 路径)、本 head CI 全绿,然后按席位的落地路线走。

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`

Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/system/operation-message.ts + packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/lifecycle-hooks.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approvals-plugin.ts, packages/spec/src/system/operation-message.test.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/record-lock-user-facing-message.test.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/record-lock-batch-row-status.integration.test.ts
Security-touching: yes

Face: schema, path limb (`packages/spec/src/system/operation-message.ts`). First L2 on this PR. Inputs: card #34060 with every comment (ruling 6919084325, claim 6925170971, dev report 6927007046), PR #34449 body, files, net diff against merge-base a121e29c28, PR comments (final-head 6927053968), check-runs on this head, #32655, and the cited code at the head. No touched source file moved on `main` after the merge-base.

`Security-touching: yes` is meant narrowly: the new catalog docblock states which sentence a writer is served when the title or label is not available to them. It restates the existing rule and changes no behaviour.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Wire vocabulary unchanged.** `lockedError` is untouched: `code` `RECORD_LOCKED`, `statusCode` 409, the `RECORD_LOCKED: ` prefix and the error's property set are as on `main`. The three operator-facing lock refusals are untouched.
- **English byte-identical.** The four `en` templates equal the four branches of the old template literal, character for character:
  - label and title: `{{object}} '{{title}}' is locked while an approval is in progress, and cannot be edited until that approval is complete`
  - title only: `'{{title}}' …`
  - label only: `This {{object}} …`
  - neither: `This record …`
  The key choice in `recordLockRefusal` is the old `subject` ternary, on the same truthiness tests. Interpolation is single-pass with a function replacer, so a `$` sequence or a `{{` in a value is printed as written on the built-in path.
- **No verdict moves.** Every added line runs after the lock decision, inside the branch that already ends in `lockedError`. The caller exemptions, `gatingRequests`, the run-identity pass and the status-mirror pass are not in the diff. The lookups are caught (`refusalLocalization`, `readerLabelsFor`, `renderOperationMessage`). A throw there could only change the error a refused write carries, never serve it.
- **Locale source.** `ctx.session.locale` is the field `buildSession` copies from `ExecutionContext.locale` (#26170). A write with no session reads English, as before.
- **Checks on this head.** 26 success, 13 skipped, 29 in progress at the read (Build Core, Test Core 1-8, Test UI 1-16, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Type Check workspace / consumer gates / UI, one scoped lint). No failure. Not complete, and this record does not attest them.

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/spec` patch and `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` patch hold.

- `BUILTIN_OPERATION_MESSAGES` is typed `Record` of string to `Record` of string to string. Four entries per locale are added. No export, type, Zod schema or generated surface changes (`api-surface/system.json` and `export-origins/system.json` name the const only and are not in the diff).
- `Metadata-protocol: none` holds: nothing a metadata author can write is added to a schema. The `errors.KEY` override address is the catalog's existing one, read through `II18nService.t`.
- `Clause-②: no` holds: no request that was served is refused, and none that was refused is served. Only the sentence moves, and only for a caller whose locale the catalog carries.
- Precedent: the `duplicate_record*` keys were added to the same catalog in 18.5.0 as a patch.
- `bindApprovalLockHook` gains an optional fourth parameter. Existing three-argument callers are unaffected.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev report `open_questions`:** empty. `security_findings`: none. `out_of_scope_findings`: none.
- **Dev deviations, answered:**
  - File surface wider than the claim (`operation-message.ts` and its test, `approvals-plugin.ts`): accepted. The catalog is the "platform message catalogue" the claim's Shape names, and `approvals-plugin.ts` is the one call site.
  - REST re-measure not committed: accepted. The permanent pins run the real engine, the real hook and the real `updateManyData` / `batchData` loops.
  - PR-body trailer and commit trailers: process matters for the seat, no contract effect.
- **SQL push-down:** no new query, id materialisation or in-app join. The hook reads what it read before (`engine.getSchema`, `ctx.previous`, the served-fields answer).
- **Disclosure:** the sentence names the same two things as on `main`: the written object's label and the record's title as served to the writer. The label now comes from the pack entry for that same object. The title path is unchanged. No new fact reaches the writer.

### ④ Design judgment

**`packages/spec/src/system/operation-message.ts`, against #34060, #32655 and its first consumer.**

- **Rule followed.** #32655 puts user-facing refusal text in the request locale. The catalog is the seat the module names for this family, and the hook reuses `renderOperationMessage`. No second mechanism.
- **Key naming.** `record_locked` follows the code-named pattern of `delete_restricted` / `DELETE_RESTRICTED`. Every `RECORD_LOCKED` emitter in the tree (plugin-approvals, service-storage) is the approval lock, so the name does not claim a second situation. `_opaque` is the existing suffix. `_untitled` and `_unlabeled` are new and say which parameter is absent.
- **Placeholders.** `{{object}}` is the name `delete_restricted*` already uses for an object label. `{{title}}` is new to the catalog and documented in the docblock. The situation table gains its row.
- **Key by key, locale by locale.** All four locales carry all four keys with exactly these placeholders: `record_locked` (object, title), `record_locked_untitled` (object), `record_locked_unlabeled` (title), `record_locked_opaque` (none).
  - zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES each say the same two things as English: locked while an approval is in progress, and not editable until it completes.
  - Each quotes the title its own way (corner brackets, guillemets).
  - None names an id or API name.
- **Enumerations.** The existing every-locale-defines-every-key test covers the new keys. No docs page, skill, checklist item or generated artifact lists the key set or quotes the English sentence. Nothing is stale.

**`lifecycle-hooks.ts` and `approvals-plugin.ts`, against the catalog contract.**

- **Key choice** matches what the hook has in hand. Parameters are passed, never spliced.
- **Label ladder:** the pack's `objects.OBJECT.label` through the plugin's existing `readerLabelsFor` (negotiated, so bare `zh` reaches zh-CN), else the declared label, never the API name.
- **Service wiring:** the same lazy `i18nService` closure the plugin's other i18n consumers read.
- **Fallbacks read in code and pinned in the diff's tests:**
  - no locale: English
  - unknown locale: English
  - bare `zh`: zh-CN sentence and label
  - no i18n service: built-in catalog with the declared label
  - throwing service: wording degrades, lock holds
  - deployment override: wins
  - `updateMany` and `batchData` upsert rows: same sentence, `code` and `httpStatus` 409
- **Note, not a finding.** For an English writer the template is identical, but `{{object}}` now follows the pack or the i18n service's own fallback locale when either answers for that object. The approvals inbox labels the object the same way.

S1 (should-fix) — the `errors.record_locked*` override is asked of the i18n service with the raw request tag, while the label in the same refusal is asked with the negotiated tag. Where the service matches tags exactly (`FileI18nAdapter.resolveFromLocale`), a bare `zh` writer reads the zh-CN label inside the built-in zh-CN sentence and the deployment's zh-CN override is skipped. objectql's catalog callers negotiate first (`negotiatedMessageLocale`). The in-plugin sibling `approval_recall_not_submitter` has the same gap, so this can be one follow-up for both. No pin covers override with bare `zh`. Read from the code, not run.

N1 (nit) — the `BUILTIN_OPERATION_MESSAGES` docblock reads "…for a single field or none. *" and the next paragraph follows without a blank comment line. The two paragraphs are glued in the published declaration comment.

N2 (nit) — `{{title}}` is the first catalog parameter that carries row content. On the override path the text is interpolated by the service and again by the renderer, so a title that itself contains a placeholder is expanded on the second pass. Only the two values already in the sentence can appear. The built-in path is single-pass. No test pins a title containing `{{`.
